description: This file declares functions and enums related to device shutdown procedures, including reboot reasons, status codes, and related operations.

methods.name: icShutdown
methods.description: Performs device shutdown or reboot based on the specified reason.

methods.name: icDelayedShutdown
methods.description: Performs shutdown after a specified delay.

methods.name: getShutdownReasonCode
methods.description: Reads and deletes the shutdown reason file, returning the shutdown reason enum.

methods.name: peekShutdownReasonCode
methods.description: Reads the shutdown reason file without deleting it, returning the shutdown reason enum.

methods.name: getShutdownStatusCode
methods.description: Reads and deletes the shutdown status code file, returning the status code.

methods.name: peekShutdownStatusCode
methods.description: Reads the shutdown status code file without deleting it.

methods.name: getShutdownCodeForString
methods.description: Converts a string to a shutdownReason enum value.

methods.name: recordShutdownReasonOnStartUp
methods.description: Records shutdown reason at startup and removes existing reason files.
